kernel.qk: per-16-row Q / per-64-row K signed INT8 Tensor Core IMMA with INT32 accumulation
kernel.pv: Recommended FP16 probability x FP16 V, or experimental U8 probability x INT8 V; both use FP32 accumulation
kernel.source: Star7 SLA Q128/K64 and threshold-routed Sol Q64/K64 over Apache-2.0 SageAttention SM75 and Comfy Kitchen primitives
kernel.sol_preprocess: native CUDA Q/K/V centroid reduction, diagonal threshold routing, LUT packing, and FP16-to-INT8 quantization
kernel.sol_fp16_pv_math: selected K64 blocks exact; unselected K64 blocks contribute through K/V centroids in the same FP32 online softmax
kernel.sol_all_int8_math: same exact-plus-centroid Sol softmax as FP16-PV; only the exact and centroid PV products use INT8 Tensor Cores
